case_evidence.interpretation_boundary: The report supports a mixed aggregate task result and a stability hypothesis; it does not expose enough semantic intermediate tensors to attribute the seed difference to a particular example.

trace_adequacy.target_boundary: Targets and labels remain outside plugin inputs and trace-derived gates.
trace_adequacy.notes: The formal artifact is structurally traceable but incomplete for source-first semantic Case Study attribution. The new toy must emit the two-view agreement and gate explicitly.

intervention_execution.claim: Q-CEASC executes a finite, masked, zero-sum context-only residual with out-of-span projected support.

intended_intermediate.claim: The current report does not identify which support examples are reliable; seed-level geometry suggests the intervention magnitude alone is insufficient to explain utility.

observable_output.claim: The same Q-CEASC mechanism improves or degrades held-out Macro-F1 depending on seed, and its validation-to-test transfer is inconsistent.

task_utility.claim: Mean task utility is positive but the paired uncertainty interval crosses zero, so reproducible utility is not established.

primary_explanation.statement: An unconditional support residual can be useful on some query-context states and harmful on others; the missing reliability signal produces seed-sensitive task transfer.

alternative_explanations.statement: The observed spread may be dominated by ordinary optimizer and baseline stochasticity rather than support reliability.
The matched classical control may capture part of the same useful geometry, limiting quantum-specific attribution.

discriminating_measurement.uncertainty: Per-case agreement and gated residual dispersion must be measured on fixed training and generation cases before utility outcomes are inspected.
discriminating_measurement.measurement: Generate two independent label-free Q-CEASC support views, record their residual cosine agreement, apply the predeclared non-negative agreement gate, and compare to single-view and matched classical two-view controls.
discriminating_measurement.primary_outcome: Low-agreement cases receive a smaller intervention while high-agreement cases retain nonzero out-of-span support; gated residual dispersion and harmful-case rate decrease without collapsing useful support.
discriminating_measurement.alternative_outcome: Agreement is unrelated to task-aligned utility, collapses the residual, or is exactly reproduced by the classical two-view control.

forbidden_rescue_variants: claiming L2 from a higher mean alone

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Use query and active context keys to construct a label-free support vector projected outside a frozen action span.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Preserve context-only inputs, entity masking, zero-sum residuals, and explicit out-of-span diagnostics.

positive_carryovers.mechanism: Use the same two-view composition and gate with independent classical span controls.
positive_carryovers.transport_constraint: Keep parameter count, data order, optimizer, masks, and evaluation protocol matched.

selected_candidate.title: Stability-certified two-view Q-CEASC residual
selected_candidate.causal_difference: Replace unconditional residual application with a label-free agreement-certified combination of two independent support views.
selected_candidate.discriminating_measurement: Per-case residual agreement, gate activity, gated residual dispersion, and paired comparison against single-view and classical two-view controls.
selected_candidate.success_gate: Five fixed toy seeds pass finite/mask/zero-sum/projection checks; agreement gate is non-collapsed and context-sensitive; out-of-span support remains nonzero; quantum and classical two-view budgets match; and the gated mechanism is not an exact single-view or classical replay.
selected_candidate.kill_condition: Kill if the gate collapses support, agreement does not predict or reduce harmful interventions, the matched classical two-view control reproduces the result, or any mask/entity/target-boundary invariant fails.
selected_candidate.authorization_boundary: Bounded toy implementation and review only; no production full-data run, collaborator handoff, L2 claim, or novelty claim is authorized by this dossier.

limitations: The formal report has only three seeds and its semantic case traces are incomplete.
The stability hypothesis is not yet observed; it is a falsifiable proposal derived from mixed seed-level outcomes.
Two independent views approximately double plugin compute and parameter count; all runtime and memory costs must be reported.
Exact statevector toy behavior is not evidence of hardware quantum advantage.
